title: Keep the Mac awake while the agents work?
instructions: The Mac went into idle sleep three times today, for 15 minutes each (12:27, 12:55, 13:12Z), which pauses every agent and could spoil a measurement. I can run macOS's built-in 'caffeinate -i': it only stops the Mac's idle sleep (the screen can still turn off), changes no settings, and ends on its own after 4 hours or when I stop it. Recommended: awake for 4 h.
